title: Granny boho bag - free pattern
author: Pradeepa (The Lazy Hobbyhopper)
notes: Only the square motif of the bag (Rounds 1-16) is kept; joining, strap and attaching omitted. Starts with a magic ring as published. 'Round 6 to 8' / 'Round 12 to 16' written as 'Round 6-8' / 'Round 12-16'. Line breaks inside rounds joined. Rounds 9/10/11 counts derived from the stitch counts of round 8 (29 sts between corner sts). Stitch graph: round 9 reads badly (cost 174.6); check where its stitches go.
